verdict.rationale: Aircall documents some batch-style capabilities of its own. Users can import up to 1,000 numbers and dial them in sequence (aircall-docs-18), and the API can create, launch, pause and resume Campaigns, which act on many contacts at once (aircall-docs-17). Both are narrow, dialing-specific workflows rather than general bulk operations across items. missing for 10: general bulk edit/update/delete/tag operations across calls, contacts or users; batch API endpoints; documented bulk actions for AI or agent-driven workflows; independent or hands-on corroboration.
